Triad Wars Community FAQ

What is Triad Wars?

  • Set in the vibrant city of Hong Kong and the Sleeping Dogs universe, Triad Wars is an online open-world action adventure PC game where you rise to power as a criminal kingpin of the Triad underworld. You’ll experience an unrivaled combination of fighting, shooting, & driving. It’s your city to claim, & how you do it is entirely up to you.

How much does Triad Wars cost?

  • Triad Wars is free to download and play!

Do I have to spend money? Is Triad Wars pay-to-win?

  • No! Although you can opt to spend gold on customization and Favor packs, there’s nothing in the game you can’t acquire just by playing; it just might take a little longer. You can also earn gold by trading in Favors or laundering money through your safehouse. At United Front Games we’re committed to balancing the game for all players, not just those who choose to spend real money.

If I spend money now will I get to keep my stuff after the beta ends?

  • Yes! We have no plans to do a character wipe, ever.

I tried to buy something in the store; why did it get turned down?

Is Triad Wars an MMO? Why don’t I see other people?

  • Triad Wars is not an MMO. Triad Wars is asynchronous multiplayer, but more multiplayer modes are in the works. For now, this means that while you’re not interacting directly with other players, you will interact with an AI version of their Enforcer and raid the Turf and Safehouse they’ve set up. Likewise, other players will raid your Turf and Safehouse. You’ll see the results in your notifications and can track your progress on the leaderboards.

  • Although Triad Wars is asynchronous, you can still add other players to your Friends list and chat with them.

The game seems pretty polished, why are you still in Beta?

  • We have a number of big pieces left to add so we’re not calling the game v1.0 yet.

Will you be resetting the server when the beta ends?

  • We have no plans to reset the server ever again.

Is this a sequel to Sleeping Dogs?

  • Triad Wars is its own game, neither a sequel nor a prequel. It’s based in the Sleeping Dogs universe and you’ll see many of the same familiar places, but Triad Wars takes place several years before the events of Sleeping Dogs. You’ll take on the role of a Triad Enforcer aiming to rise to power in the Hong Kong underworld amid an epic gang war, ultimately building and maintaining your own criminal empire.

Is there anything to do besides raiding?

  • Lots! The open world is filled with Operations, short missions that let you earn many different types of rewards to aid you in your rise to power. We are always working on new gameplay modes as well.

Can I customize my character?

  • Yes, you can customize your character’s clothes, face, hair, and more.

Will I have a house? Can I customize it?

  • You’ll have a Safehouse and a Turf; you can actively customize the layout of the rackets in your Turf, and your Safehouse will look different (and better) every time you upgrade it. Your Safehouse starts out pretty grimy but you can level it up until it’s a ballin’ penthouse!

Can I choose which drive Triad Wars installs to? * During the installation of the launcher you can select ‘options’ and choose which drive you prefer.

How big is the download?

  • The initial download is approximately 6 gigs (for the medium graphics pack), patches after that are much smaller.

Will more features be added than what’s in the beta?

  • Yes! Because Triad Wars is a live game, we can and will continue to expand the gameplay and features even beyond the beta.

How do I ask the team a question? * There are a variety of ways to get in touch with the team. Posting on the forums is great way to contact us. You can also tune into our twitch stream every other Thursday and ask questions in the chat, or feel free to hit us up at www.Facebook.com/triadwars and @TriadWars on twitter. If you have a problem, and don't want everyone else to read your issue, you can send a PM to @IainUFG (that’s iain) or DylanUFG, or an email to community@triadwars.com.

Where else can I find out information about the game?

  • Aside from these forums check out these great resources to learn about the game:
  • Triad Wars Wiki at http://triadwars.gamepedia.com/Triad_Wars_Wiki
  • Check out are past streams on Twitch: http://www.twitch.tv/triadwars/profile/past_broadcasts
